SELECT /*selectSellerMpIvObtnodrMultiReceiptList*/ (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(COD.CODE),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE 1=1 AND COD.CODE = E.CMS_CATEG_ID AND COD.TYPE = 'CM11' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y') AS COD_CHECK, ---ICOMCOD1 CHECK DECODE(TRIM(E.MSDS_NO),'','Y','MS88888888','Y','N') AS MSDS_CHECK, --BYIT.MSDS_NO CHECK (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO),0,'N','Y') FROM KEP_CMC_REQ REQ WHERE 1=1 AND REQ.BUYER = A.BUYER AND REQ.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = E.BUYER AND REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = E.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND REQ.AGENT = C.AGENT AND REQ.REQ_STATUS NOT IN ('B','C','D','N','T')) AS REQ_CHECK, ---REQ CHECK DECODE(E.MATERIAL_TYPE, 'H', 'Y', 'N') AS HARMFUL_CHECK, DECODE(TRIM(E.TEMP_COND), '', 'Y', NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS TEMP_CHECK, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(COD.CODE),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE 1=1 AND COD.CODE = E.CMS_CATEG_ID AND COD.TYPE = 'CM11' AND COD.TEXT1 = 'Y' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y') AS SG118_CHECK, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(IMP.COL01_DATA), 0, '', MAX(IMP.COL01_DATA)) FROM BNTSLGDEF DEF, BNTSLGIMP IMP WHERE DEF.SLG_ID = IMP.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DEF.OPEN_DATE AND DEF.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN IMP.OPEN_DATE AND IMP.CLOSE_DATE AND DEF.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000033' AND IMP.COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS P070000033_CHECK, E.TEMP_COND, '/ ' || (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M203' AND CODE = E.TEMP_COND AND FLAG = 'Y') AS TEMP_COND_TEXT, '/ ' || E.TEMP_RANGE AS TEMP_RANGE, DECODE(E.MATERIAL_TYPE, 'H', '/ 유해화학물질','') AS HARMFUL_TEXT, F_GET_EXPORT_BUYER_NAME(A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS BUYER_NAME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, DECODE(A.PROXY_BUY_FLAG, 'PX', A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE, DECODE(A.PROXY_BUY_FLAG, 'PX', A.AGENT_ITEM_AMT, A.ITEM_AMT) AS ITEM_AMT, C.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, A.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE , A.BUYER AS BUYER, F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(A.BUYER, '01') AS BUYER2, A.PO_NO AS PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, A.DS_FLAG AS DS_FLAG, A.DS_DELAY_REASON AS DS_DELAY_REASON, DECODE(NVL(A.DS_DELAY_REASON ,'icon') , 'icon' ,'but_img_off.gif' ,'but_img_on.gif') AS DS_DELAY_REASON_IMG, A.SELLER AS SELLER, A.DS_DATE AS DS_DATE, C.DS_FLAG AS H_DS_FLAG, A.PO_REMARK ||DECODE(TRIM(A.LEGACY_PO_NO),NULL,' ', ' ('||A.LEGACY_PO_NO||' , '||A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ||') ')||DECODE(TRIM(A.REF_IF_NO),NULL,NULL,'('||A.REF_IF_NO||')') AS PO_REMARK, C.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, B.IMAGE_KEY AS IMAGE_KEY, (SELECT BYIT.REFINE_NOTE FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT, ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE BYIT.BUYER = CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS REFINE_NOTE, (SELECT DECODE(MAX(WM.WMRE_NO),'','N','Y') FROM BNTWMRE WM WHERE WM.BUYER = A.BUYER AND WM.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND WM.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ ) WMRE_NO_YN, (SELECT DECODE(MAX(WM.WMRE_NO),'','N','Y') FROM BNTWMRE WM WHERE WM.BUYER = A.BUYER AND WM.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND WM.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND WM.CANCEL_DATE IS NULL AND WM.END_DATE IS NULL ) WMRE_CANCEL_NO_YN, E.MAKER_PART_NO, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, (SELECT COUNT(DT.PO_SEQ) FROM ICOMPODT DT WHERE DT.BUYER = A.BUYER AND DT.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND DT.STATUS != 'D') PO_CNT, (SELECT MAX(USR.USER_NAME_LOC) AS USER_NAME_LOC FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG, ICOMLUSR USR WHERE MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND MNG.STATUS != 'O' AND MNG.KEP_USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) AS USER_NAME_LOC, (SELECT MAX(USR.PHONE_NUMBER) AS USER_NAME_LOC FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG, ICOMLUSR USR WHERE MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND MNG.STATUS != 'O' AND MNG.KEP_USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) AS USER_PHONE_NUMBER, B.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, (SELECT COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.COMPANY_CODE=B.BUYER AND COD.TYPE='C001' AND COD.CODE=B.ADD_USER_DEPT) AS REQ_USER_DEPT, DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.COMPANY_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND COD.TYPE = 'C012' AND COD.CODE = '001' ), C.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, C.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, F_GET_BUY_CLOSE_DATE_CHK(A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, C.AGENT) AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE_CHK, A.ST_DATE, C.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PH_PO_DATE, A.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM BNTSLGIMP WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN OPEN_DATE AND CLOSE_DATE AND COM_CODE = B.BUYER AND SLG_ID = 'P06-0000121') AS PORS_CHECK, A.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, A.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND TEXT4 = 'B' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE), 0, 'N', 'Y'),'N') AS TR_WAREHOUSE_YN FROM ICOMPRDT B, ICOMPODT A , ICOMPOHD C, ICOMCMPY D, ICOMBYIT E WHERE B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = D.COM_CODE AND A.BUYER = D.COM_CODE AND C.BUYER = D.COM_CODE AND D.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = E.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = E.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.DS_FLAG = 'N' AND C.COMPLETE_MARK ='N' AND A.COMPLETE_MARK ='N' AND C.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS != 'D' AND CLOSE_FLAG = 'N') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_PO_MNG WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND STATUS = 'S' AND TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT4 = 'Y') ) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'MHUB_CHG' AND TARGET = A.BUYER AND KEY_1 = A.PO_NO AND KEY_9 = 'N' ) = 0
AND (A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_buyer_code})
AND (A.PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%') OR A.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%'))
AND B.REQ_USER_INFO LIKE '%'||#{st_req_user_info}||'%'
ORDER BY BUYER_NAME, RD_DATE, BUYER, BUYER2
